title: Atlas Geometry Component v1
description: Structural schema for an AtlasGeometryComponent record — geometry METADATA describing one named solid/compound, not the kernel-native OpenCascade geometry itself. See docs/bible/07-atlas/130-component-contract.md. The current backend's GeneratedComponent dataclass (backend/jewelmind/geometry/model.py) is the CURRENT partial implementation this schema generalizes.

componentId.description: Stable identifier within one assembly, e.g. "band", "prongs".

componentType.description: CURRENT: band/stone_reference/basket_support are single solids; prongs is a compound of N solids.

geometryRole.description: CURRENT mapping: band/prongs/basket_support -> production_metal; stone_reference -> stone_reference. No component is currently support-only or preview_only as a distinct role — see docs/bible/07-atlas/130-component-contract.md.

productionRole.description: CURRENT: production_metal components are included_by_default in STEP/STL; stone_reference is excluded_by_default (opt-in via includeStoneReference).

previewRole.description: CURRENT: every component (including stone_reference) is visible in preview.

sourceJDLPaths.description: Canonical JDL field paths this component's geometry derives from.

derivedParameters.description: Values computed from JDL fields, e.g. innerRadiusMm, outerRadiusMm — mirrors the component's real `metadata` dict.

geometry.description: Deliberately does not serialize the actual B-Rep/mesh — this schema describes geometry metadata, never kernel-native geometry. See docs/bible/07-atlas/122-geometric-representation-model.md.

transform.description: PLANNED — no component currently records an explicit local-to-world transform object; placement is implicit in the construction code (workplane offsets). See docs/bible/07-atlas/125-transformations.md.

inspectionResults.description: PLANNED — no component currently carries embedded AtlasInspection results; see specs/atlas/v1/geometry-inspection-result.schema.json and docs/bible/07-atlas/140-geometry-inspection-framework.md.
